item.title: London society frets as King Charles skips major high-culture event
item.description: CARDIFF, WALES - OCTOBER 15: King Charles III waves and smiles to well-wishers as he departs after the Ceremonial Opening Of The Seventh Senedd on October 15, 2026 in Cardiff, Wales. Today's ceremony in the Siambr will mark the formal opening of the seventh Senedd. The occasion is significant as it marks the start of the expanded Senedd and is the first such opening to be attended by King Charles III since his accession. (Photo by Chris Jackson/Getty Images)
